title: My Day: Get Up, Work, Walk, Go Home, Sleep
label: ch:ja-my-day-get-up-work-walk-go-home-sleep
canDo: I can say what I do every day with the polite -masu form, and find the stem of a verb: I get up, I work, I walk, I go home, I go to bed.

payoff.summary: Say a whole day in order with five polite verbs, okimasu, hatarakimasu, arukimasu, kaerimasu and nemasu, and give the dictionary form beside each one.
